sources.title: TMP-Net: Terrain Matching and Positioning Network by Highly Reliable ...
sources.snippet: The model-driven terrain matching and aircraft positioning network (TMP-Net) is capable of realizing aircraft positioning by utilizing the real-time DDMs to match with the DEM-based DDM references, which are generated by a point-by-point coupling mechanism between the airborne routine and ground terrain DEM.
